title: Summative Test 1 — Physics Foundations & Machines
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: Which branch of science studies matter, energy, motion and force?
options: Physics
Chemistry
Biology
Ecology
questions.correct: Physics

questions.text: A refrigerator keeps food fresh by moving heat out of its compartment. Which area of life does this MAINLY improve?
options: Household
Leisure and recreation
Work productivity
Transportation only
questions.correct: Household

questions.text: Seat belts hold passengers in place when a car stops suddenly. Which physics idea explains why they are needed?
options: Inertia keeps the body moving forward
Gravity pushes the body toward the seat
Friction makes the car stop more slowly
Air pressure pulls passengers backward
questions.correct: Inertia keeps the body moving forward

questions.text: Eyeglasses help a nearsighted student see the board clearly. Which property of light do they use?
options: Refraction of light through a lens
Reflection of light from a mirror
Absorption of light by the dark glass
Emission of light from the frames
questions.correct: Refraction of light through a lens

questions.text: Which device in a hospital uses magnets and radio waves to make images of the body?
options: MRI scanner
Stethoscope
Thermometer
Blood-pressure cuff
questions.correct: MRI scanner

questions.text: Why do basketball shoes have rubber soles with deep grooves?
options: To increase friction and prevent slipping
To reduce friction so players slide faster
To make the shoes lighter and more stylish
To absorb sound when the player is running
questions.correct: To increase friction and prevent slipping

questions.text: A tricycle driver must stop on a wet road. Compared with a dry road, what should he do and why?
options: Brake earlier, since less friction means a longer stop
Brake later, since the water adds more friction to the tires
Brake harder at the last second to stop instantly
Drive faster, since speed reduces sliding on water
questions.correct: Brake earlier, since less friction means a longer stop

questions.text: A barangay must choose ONE project to improve safety at a busy school crossing. Which choice is BEST supported by physics?
options: Speed humps, since slower cars stop in shorter distances
Brighter paint on the school gate, so it looks cleaner
A taller flagpole, so the school is easier for drivers to find
More trees by the road, so drivers feel cooler
questions.correct: Speed humps, since slower cars stop in shorter distances

questions.text: What is the SI unit of angular displacement?
options: Radian
Meter
Second
Newton
questions.correct: Radian

questions.text: Which is an example of PURELY translational motion?
options: A box sliding straight across a floor
A ceiling fan spinning in place
A wheel rolling down a long, steep ramp
A merry-go-round turning
questions.correct: A box sliding straight across a floor

questions.text: A wheel rolls along the road without slipping. Which motion does it have?
options: Both translational and rotational
Translational motion only
Rotational motion only
Neither, since all its forces are balanced
questions.correct: Both translational and rotational

questions.text: Which equation relates linear speed v to angular velocity ω?
options: v = r × ω
v = ω ÷ r
v = r ÷ ω
v = r + ω
questions.correct: v = r × ω

questions.text: Two children sit on a turning merry-go-round, one near the edge and one near the center. What do they have in common?
options: The same angular velocity
The same linear speed
The same distance traveled
The same centripetal path
questions.correct: The same angular velocity

questions.text: How many radians are in one complete revolution?
options: 2π radians
π radians
π/2 radians
360 radians
questions.correct: 2π radians

questions.text: A bicycle wheel of radius 0.35 m turns at 10 rad/s. What is the bicycle's speed?
options: 35 m/s

questions.text: A fan blade spins at a constant ω. Point X is 10 cm from the center; point Y is 30 cm. Which comparison is correct?
options: Y moves 3 times as fast as X
X moves 3 times as fast as Y
X and Y move at the same speed
Y has 3 times the angular velocity
questions.correct: Y moves 3 times as fast as X

questions.text: What is torque?
options: The turning effect of a force
The weight of an object
The speed of a rotating body
The energy stored in a spring
questions.correct: The turning effect of a force

questions.text: Why is a door handle placed far from the hinges?
options: A longer lever arm gives more torque
It looks better near the door edge
It makes the whole door lighter to carry
It keeps the hinges from rusting
questions.correct: A longer lever arm gives more torque

questions.text: Which of these is a COMPOUND machine?
options: Bicycle
Ramp
Wedge
Single fixed pulley
questions.correct: Bicycle

questions.text: Why is no real machine 100% efficient?
options: Some input energy is lost as heat from friction
Machines create new energy while working
Output work is always much greater than the input work
Machines run on force, not on energy
questions.correct: Some input energy is lost as heat from friction

questions.text: A worker uses a lever to lift a 600 N rock with a 150 N push. What is the mechanical advantage?
Two wrenches loosen the same bolt. Wrench P is 20 cm long; wrench Q is 40 cm. With the same push at the handle end, what happens?
options: Q gives twice the torque of P
P gives twice the torque of Q
Both give exactly equal torque
Q gives half the torque of P
questions.correct: Q gives twice the torque of P

questions.text: Students must design a machine to lift a 20 kg sack of rice onto a truck with the least effort. Which design is BEST?
options: A long ramp with a cart on oiled wheels
A short, steep ramp with no wheels at all
A single fixed pulley with a thin rope
A short lever with the pivot near the effort
questions.correct: A long ramp with a cart on oiled wheels

questions.text: What does Pascal's principle state?
options: Pressure on an enclosed fluid is transmitted equally
Fluids always flow from a small pipe to a much larger pipe
Pressure in a fluid is greatest at the surface
Liquids can be squeezed into a smaller volume
questions.correct: Pressure on an enclosed fluid is transmitted equally

questions.text: Why does a hydraulic jack use oil rather than air?
options: Liquids are nearly incompressible
Oil is lighter than air
Air is too expensive to use in a jack
Oil makes the jack much colder
questions.correct: Liquids are nearly incompressible

questions.text: Pressure is defined as which quantity?
options: Force divided by area
Area divided by force
Force multiplied by area
Mass divided by volume
questions.correct: Force divided by area

questions.text: Why does a sharp knife cut better than a dull one with the same push?
options: Smaller area gives greater pressure
A sharp blade is heavier than a dull one
A dull blade has less force per push
Smaller area gives smaller pressure
questions.correct: Smaller area gives greater pressure

questions.text: In a hydraulic lift, how does the large piston produce a large output force?
options: Same pressure acts on a larger area
It pushes the oil faster than the small piston
It has a higher pressure than the small piston
It adds extra fluid from a hidden reservoir
questions.correct: Same pressure acts on a larger area

questions.text: A hydraulic press has a small piston of 0.01 m² and a large piston of 0.50 m². A 200 N force is applied. What is the output force?
options: 4 N

questions.text: A car mechanic wants a jack that lifts a car with less effort. Which change helps MOST?
options: Make the output piston's area much larger
Make both pistons exactly the same size
Replace the oil with air for a lighter jack
Make the output piston's area much smaller
questions.correct: Make the output piston's area much larger
